english.note: This is the usual choice when “bureaucracy” means burdensome red tape and excessive procedures.

examples.english: This application involves so much bureaucracy that I still haven't sorted it out after several weeks.
examples.traditional: 呢份申請表有太多繁文縟節，搞到我幾個星期都未搞掂。
